horoscopes.horoscope: Something unexpected may happen. Though you may not comprehend all that takes place, Ganesha says it is fine. Stay away from stressful activity, as you may need to go out in the evening. Put on the glitter and gloss, as some good music and dance are expected to come your way. An argument may erupt between you and your life partner. This is the time to be cautious, warns Ganesha. You should not react to your partner unnecessarily, rather you should remain calm and sort out the issue tactfully, suggests Ganesha. Ganesha feels that today you will be starting your day with good mood and your health may also remain good. However, as the day progresses, things will start changing to negative. Avoid being very argumentative with others and be more understanding. Ganesha feels that during the first half of the day, you are going to have good financial gains. Stars are in favour for earning through various sources. This is a good time to tap for pending payments. The day will surprise you at various occasions. The important discussions can be scheduled for the first half of the day as the second half of the day is not lucky for you and you may end up wasting time on pursuing unnecessary tasks.

You are hard working by nature but get highly frustrated when things do not end the way you had imagined, feels Ganesha. This may lead to anger against the system or the order in which things work. You will vent your frustration on your routine by longing for an alternate lifestyle, wishing and hoping for more relaxation and perhaps a spontaneous vacation. Till evening, time doesn’t seem right for love and romance. It will flourish only after that, says Ganesha. You may spend some valuable times over the snacks with your loved one. You may pay attention to your sweetheart’s feelings, foresees Ganesha. Today you will remain in good health. Your mood will also not swing much. You will be able to stay focussed on everything that you need to address. Towards second half of the day, you are likely to feel more emotional. Ganesha feels that the day is going to be excellent for laying foundation of long term financial future. today you will be able to get good business or work for the organization. You will understand today that hard work always pays off. You will give your best today. You may not remain flexible. You will see the results of the efforts you take. You will succeed on the career front as opportunities will knock at your door.

There is every possibility that you will keep your partner in the loop while making important decisions today, predicts Ganesha. And this will prevent a grave misunderstanding. Later in the day, you will benefit from the insights of your soul mate. You will tend to be a little bit on the spiritual side today. Take some time off from work and be with your family. The earlier you clarify issues in love life, the better. You tend to ease some critical aspects of the relationship. Managing your emotional feelings won’t be difficult once you are with your loved one. The day is good to take major decisions. You need not worry for the decisions which you take, says Ganesha. At the same time, you could be very communicative today and try to sort out misunderstandings if they are there. If you owe money to someone or to some bank, it’s a good day to repay full amount or a big chunk of it. During second half of the day, you will be doing very well in your job or business, thus in finances too. Maximum time of the day will be spent attending meetings in the office. You should not be confused in the meetings or should not at least show your indecisive appearance. Otherwise, your capabilities will be doubted and you may miss some important opportunities.

Ganesha says you will win over people with your oratory. So it will speed up your work. In the afternoon, you will get news of monetary gain in the office. Be on the guard, minor ailments may bother you, warns Ganesha. In love life, Ganesha finds you getting emotional every now and then. Even petty issues may make you sad. You may have to depend on your spouse a lot. Only time will tell you when your relationship will get easy. You need to express your sweetheart to maintain a smooth relationship. The day may not begin on a very good note, says Ganesha. You will be very sincere in work but it is not certain whether your sincerity will get proven. You will feel loved by others later in the day, which could make you happy. If you were worried in the first half of the day about money matters, during second half you will be happy to have found a sensible solution. A long-distance trip that you start today will surely be gainful. Your pessimistic approach in the morning will change into an optimistic one towards the end of the day. Balancing your emotions, you will be as kind as possible to your colleagues. The challenging issues are likely to get solved with cooperation with your teammates.

Businessmen and traders need to be wary of their competitors. They will be jealous of your progress and will hatch nefarious schemes to pull you down, warns Ganesha. You may be looking for a loyal partner who wants to maintain a long-term relationship. However, trust is the basis of any relation and hence to maintain a cordial relation, you have to trust the person concerned. You should develop a thorough understanding of your partner. You need to take care of your health if you want the day not to go bad, says Ganesha. At the same time, you should avoid confronting with anybody. Your personal and professional fronts are going to remain tighter and very demanding. Today you may regret some of your decisions but it’s late. All you can do is, now on just be more careful while spending money or while handling money. Poor financial management could result in disaster. You may tend to control a situation and may appear bossy in front of your teammates. The differences with colleagues in the office may lead to a tense environment in the first part of the day. You need to avoid thinking negatively about matters.

You will be very open-minded today, very receptive to ideas from everyone. However, when it boils down to taking decisions, it will be the stubborn ones that will prevail. Today is also a time to resolve pending issues at work. But in the evening you may enjoy a nice dinner with your beloved and summon the courage to pop that all-important question. Personal life will be your first priority today and you will spend a great deal of time with your soulmate. A compromising attitude in love is going to impress your sweetheart. You will be ready to learn a lot. A romantic time will keep your mind fresh. It’s a very good day for you from health point of view. Even though you will be fine in the early part of the day, you could feel tired towards the latter part of the day, says Ganesha. Your logical mind will function very actively. You will have idea of reorganizing money on the back of your mind but you will still have hardly any control over today’s spending. Towards end of the day, you may become firm on cutting down expenses. Adopting a systematic approach towards work will help you enhance your efficiency. You will remain disciplined till you follow the system and later change your mind. You may feel quite tired in the second half of the day. A brief chat with your client will give you the clues how to get the work done.

Ganesha says today you will wish to get away from the monotony of daily life and take a break from your work and go off on a vacation. This trip, which you will take, will be beneficial to you and will increase your knowledge and experience. You will find satisfaction and happiness in your personal relationship. In the evening time you will feel hurt by the speech or behavior of your loved ones. Love life needs some attention as your beloved may find you unromantic somehow. You may not like boring things. You may surprise your partner or bring some fresh angles to spice up your relationship. Maintaining a harmonious relationship will not be a challenge. You could fall sick today. So, you have to be careful about your health. Lessen your intake of cold drinks and avoid intoxicants. Stay positive and do not get into arguments. Avoid getting influenced by other peoples’ opinions, says Ganesha. You may need to put more stress on your pocket today because there are certain expenses that you cannot avoid. Ganesha suggests you to keep a safety pocket too, so that all the money in your wallet is not spent. You are in for an overdose of work. You will be handling the important matters today that may strain you. Your intelligence and commitment to work will be the key factors that will pull you through this important day, feels Ganesha.

It seems like a fruitful day in business, and to deal in money matters, foresees Ganesha. On the career front, you may be occupied with important meetings. Things will work out for you if you manage to strike a balance between your ideas and implementation. Heavy expenditure may be on the cards as you feel tempted to buy jewellery for your beloved, says Ganesha. It will be a lovely time on the love front. You will be in a romantic mood and will spend some memorable moments with your sweetheart. You may find your partner trustworthy and may continue to have a long-term relationship. Your sincerity may be liked by your partner. First part of your day is average from health point of view but second half will remain good in both the areas, health and mood. You should avoid interfering in other peoples’ lives. Spend time with people whom you love or who love you. You will be able to find best buy and best deals for whatever you need to purchase today. In the second half of the day, your past efforts will start giving you some financial gains. Get ready to flaunt your administrative abilities. However, tackling technical work may be a difficult task and may lead to failure. Ensure that you are not disappointed by such failures. Your planetary positions change in the second half of the day and things will start working out.

A poignant and disturbing day is in the offing. At work, Lady Luck will be on your team. Don’t let your sentiments cloud your logic though, says Ganesha. In relationship matters, don’t keep high expectation, as they may put you under tremendous pressure. You may be actively attending social gatherings and mixing up with people. You will be having a gala time with your family. You will be in a jolly mood today and this cheerful mood will influence your sweetheart to spend a quality time. As your personal and social life will be supported by good health, you are not going to face any major issue. By and large, this is going to be a good day for you from health point of view, says Ganesha. You should learn to save money for the future. Don’t fear insecurity but that doesn’t mean that one should go bankrupt or one should not have sufficient or bear minimum balance in the account. You will come in contact with people who are linked to your organization in some way or the other. Try to establish good relations with your colleagues as it will prove beneficial in future. You may not be serious today, rather you will bring your sense of humour.

The day bodes well, especially for public servants. An impending business transaction with the government will keep you busy, and suggestions from friends and peers may prove beneficial, says Ganesha. Professionals, however, need to be more proactive, as their expertise will be tested. Spending a quality time with your loved one is your motto. You will find emotional stability today. You will feel that your life is fortunate and complete with your sweetheart. You are likely to get appreciations from your loved one. Ganesha suggests you to avoid taking too much stress as it can affect your health adversely. Work life may be monotonous, but try to do more on work. Keep a check on your diet. Avoid taking major decisions and postpone pending decisions. Ganesha feels that today you will try to arrange a family gathering and a treat for them, which will entail heavy expenses, but you will be game as you wish your extended family to remain close-knit. You may behave and work in an unexpected manner, feels Ganesha. The reason is anxiety. You may just not be yourself today. The daily boring routine and a desire to break free may make you do things you generally consider immature. You need to take a practical approach today.

It’s time to have a riot with friends! You don’t always have to be goody two-shoes. Do something you’ve never done before and break a few of those self-made rules. Watch how you suddenly become irresistible to one and all, says Ganesha. You may meet your beloved over a candle light dinner. You may plan to do something crazy but your sweetheart may like to initiate that. You are likely to have a sweet fight that will eventually turn into a passion. A harmonious time will make you happy. Ganesha feels that you will be in a very good mood today. Your health will also be good. In the second half of the day, tangible results of your hard work will boost your morale. You should make the most out of this good day. Ganesha feels that the day is looking fabulous as far as money matters are concerned. During first half of the day, you will be more logical and analytical about money matters. You will feel on top of the world today. Being polite and understanding, you will make your way into people’s hearts. A perfect day to arrange meetings for discussing the development of your organization. Your open and friendly views will easily attract people.

Your peers will be the cause of a few confrontations today. Legal disputes may also arise. Take the advice of your elders to resolve these conflicts. Meditative techniques will help restore your calm, says Ganesha. You will remain confident and committed to your sweetheart, reveals Ganesha. You do not need to please your loved one tonight since your charming, desirable, and expressive look will turn up the heat on your lover. Get ready for a passionate love tonight. Ganesha foresees that today you will not be in a good mood. Day will start with some negative thought. As it progresses, negative thought will get converted into negative feeling. Ganesha suggests you to remain less concerned about others today. Day is going to start with financial pressure which may make you feel down emotionally. You will not be happy with your financial standing and you will be bit depressed about the same. The dull mood that takes hold of you at the start of the day, is not there to stay. As the day progresses, you will get back the enthusiasm you always possess. The camaraderie between you and your colleagues seems to be good today. Your attitude of taking initiatives will be appreciated.
